title: Powers
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.204 Numbered Discourses 5.204
  • 21. Kimilavagga 21. With Kimbila

Balasutta Powers

“Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, balāni. “Mendicants, there are these five powers. Katamāni pañca? What five? Saddhābalaṁ, hiribalaṁ, ottappabalaṁ, vīriyabalaṁ, paññābalaṁ—Faith, conscience, prudence, energy, and wisdom. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca balānī”ti. These are the five powers.”

Catutthaṁ.
